Job Summary

We are seeking an expert Back End Developer preferably having experience working on Zoho Applications to architect, develop, and maintain scalable web applications. This role requires learning Deluge - Language used by Zoho, including customization, integration, automation, and performance optimization. You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to develop tailored solutions that improve operational efficiency and support digital transformation initiatives.

This role involves end-to-end responsibility for server-side logic, database optimization, front-end integration, and deployment in cloud environments. The ideal candidate will demonstrate deep technical expertise in building secure, high-performance systems, collaborating in agile teams, and driving innovation through efficient code practices. You will work on mission-critical projects, ensuring seamless user experiences and robust backend services while adhering to best practices in software engineering.

Key Responsibilities


1. Zoho CRM Development and Customization

  • Design, configure, and enhance Zoho CRM modules, fields, layouts, and automation workflows
  • Build and manage custom functions, blueprints, and macros using Deluge scripting.
  • Integrate Zoho CRM with third-party applications and internal systems using REST APIs and webhooks.

2. Zoho Creator Application Development

  • Design and develop robust, scalable custom applications on the Zoho Creator platform.
  • Implement business logic through advanced Deluge scripting.
  • Develop intuitive forms, reports, and dashboards while ensuring data accuracy and performance.

3. Server-Side Development & Maintenance:

    • Design, develop, and maintain scalable server-side network components using Node.js, including Express.js or Koa.js frameworks for building RESTful APIs and micro services architectures.
    • Implement asynchronous programming patterns, event-driven architectures, and middleware for handling complex business logic, ensuring high concurrency and fault tolerance.

4. Database Optimization & Integration:

    • Ensure optimal performance of central databases (e.g., MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL) through indexing, query optimization, and schema design.
    • Manage data migration, replication, and sharding strategies to handle large-scale data volumes while maintaining responsiveness to front-end requests.

5. Front-End Integration & Collaboration:

    • Collaborate closely with front-end developers to integrate UI elements built with React.js, utilizing state management libraries like Redux or Context API, and component-based architectures for reusable UI patterns.
    • Optimize client-server interactions using GraphQL or REST APIs, implementing caching mechanisms (e.g., Redis) to reduce latency.

6. High-Performance Application Development:

    • Write testable, reusable, and efficient code following SOLID principles, with comprehensive unit/integration testing using frameworks like Jest, Mocha, or Enzyme.
    • Implement performance profiling and optimization techniques, such as code splitting, lazy loading, and memory leak detection.

7. API Development & Security:

    • Build secure and efficient RESTful APIs, incorporating rate limiting, input validation, and error handling to prevent common vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10).
    • Familiarity with advanced Node.js features like cron jobs (using node-cron), event listeners (EventEmitter), and circuit breakers (e.g., using Hystrix patterns) for resilient systems.

8. Security & Data Protection:

    • Implement robust security protocols, including encryption (e.g., AES for data at rest), HTTPS enforcement, and compliance with standards like GDPR or PCI-DSS.
    • Design data protection measures and storage solutions, such as cloud object storage (S3) and backup strategies with versioning.

9. Testing, Troubleshooting & Support:

    • Run diagnostic tests, debug defects using tools like Node Inspector or Chrome DevTools, and provide technical support for production issues.
    • Monitor application health with logging frameworks (e.g., Winston, ELK Stack) and performance metrics (e.g., New Relic or Prometheus).

10. Documentation & Reporting:

    • Document Node.js processes, including API endpoints, database schemas (using ER diagrams), and system architectures.
    • Prepare detailed reports on system performance, code reviews, and post-mortem analyses for incidents.

11. Process Improvements & Technology Adoption:

    • Recommend and implement enhancements to development processes, such as CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
    • Stay abreast of advancements in Node.js (e.g., ESM modules, async/await), React.js (e.g., Hooks, Server-Side Rendering), and database technologies (e.g., NoSQL vs. SQL trade-offs).

12. Platform Collaboration & Deployment:

    • Collaborate on Node.js-supported platforms, integrating with third-party services (e.g., payment gateways, email APIs).
    • Manage deployments on hosting environments like Zoho Catalyst, AWS (EC2, Lambda, ECS), ensuring auto-scaling, load balancing, and zero-downtime releases.

13. Code Management & Version Control:

    • Maintain backups, version control, and code repositories using GitHub, including branching strategies (Git Flow), pull requests, and code reviews.
    • Implement hooks for automated testing and deployment integration.

Working Hours & Schedule

  • Working Hours: 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM IST.
  • Working Days: Monday to Friday (full day); Second and Fourth Saturdays (half day).
  • In cases of critical deliveries or deadlines, weekends may be required, with compensatory offs provided.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience:
    • Experience with web technologies such as JavaScript, PHP, or Python is a plus.
    • Strong understanding of data modeling, relational databases, and business process automation.
    • Excellent problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business language.
    • Familiarity with agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) is preferred.
  • Zoho certifications (Zoho CRM/Zoho Creator) are a significant plus.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Strong understanding of databases, API design, and integration with cloud services (AWS, Zoho Catalyst).
    • Experience with testing frameworks, DevOps tools, and containerization.
    • Knowledge of security best practices, performance optimization, and scalable architectures.
    • Bonus: Experience with Zoho Catalyst for low-code integrations and custom app development.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Strong problem-solving abilities with analytical thinking for complex debugging.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills for cross-functional team interactions.
    • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, adapting to evolving requirements.
    • Strong attention to detail, commitment to code quality, and passion for continuous learning.
    • Adaptability to new technologies and tools in the full stack ecosystem.

Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the worlds most critical water challenges. Role Overview

The Data Scientist / Software Developer will take ownership of a lead generation engine built using Kedro pipelines. This individual will be responsible for ensuring the solution remains reliable, maintainable, scalable, and continuously improved over time.

The role requires a strong foundation in Python, including hands-on experience working with Kedro, along with solid SQL skills and comfort working in modern data environments such as Databricks. The candidate should also be able to work effectively with Power BI dashboards and have the maturity and intuition to understand data deeply, identify issues proactively, and drive meaningful enhancements.

Beyond maintenance and troubleshooting, this role is well suited for someone who is curious, takes ownership, enjoys problem-solving, and is eager to contribute to new initiatives involving machine learning and data science.

Key Responsibilities

Own and manage the existing lead generation engine built on Kedro pipelines

Refresh, update, maintain, and enhance the codebase to support evolving business needs

Troubleshoot production and data pipeline issues, identify root causes, and implement durable fixes

Resolve bugs, improve reliability, and ensure the solution remains stable and scalable

Develop, optimize, and maintain Python-based data workflows and supporting application logic

Work with structured and semi-structured data, demonstrating strong intuition and sound judgment in handling data quality, consistency, and usability

Write efficient and reliable SQL queries to support data extraction, transformation, validation, and analysis

Operate effectively in a modern data platform environment, with preference for experience in Databricks

Support, interpret, and interact with Power BI dashboards for business-facing insights and reporting

Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including business teams, analysts, and technical colleagues, to understand requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions

Identify opportunities to improve performance, maintainability, and extensibility of the current solution

Contribute to future-focused initiatives in machine learning, data science, and other innovation-driven projects

Demonstrate a high level of ownership, accountability, and proactive communication in managing deliverables

Required Qualifications

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field

2-4 years of relevant professional experience in software development, data engineering, data science, or related roles

Strong programming skills in Python

Hands-on experience building, maintaining, or enhancing Kedro pipelines

Strong SQL skills, including writing complex queries and working with data transformations

Comfort working with data-intensive systems and a demonstrated ability to understand data deeply and intuitively

Experience troubleshooting technical issues, fixing bugs, and maintaining production-ready codebases

Ability to work independently while managing ownership of a critical solution

Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams

High willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies, tools, and project domains

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with Databricks

Familiarity with Power BI dashboards, including interpreting data outputs and supporting business reporting needs

Exposure to machine learning or data science projects

Experience improving code scalability, maintainability, and performance in a production environment

Understanding of software development best practices such as version control, testing, documentation, and structured debugging

Experience in environments where data products directly support business growth, sales, or commercial operations


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is:

  • Technically strong in Python and experienced with Kedro
  • Mature and intuitive with data, with the ability to spot issues, trends, and improvement opportunities
  • Comfortable taking ownership of an important business solution end to end
  • Curious and motivated to explore new ideas, tools, and approaches
  • Proactive in troubleshooting and problem resolution
  • Interested in expanding into machine learning and broader data science initiatives
  • Collaborative, dependable, and aligned with a culture of continuous improvement

Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

  • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and Containerization technologies.

  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Design, Design Patterns, and SOLID Principles.

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Knowledge of OpenShift.

About Position:


We are looking for an experienced C++ Developer to join our platform engineering team and own the shared distributed messaging and networking library that serves as the communication backbone of our analytics platform. This highly scalable library enables seamless communication between packet capture, protocol analysis, decryption, and downstream processing systems with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability.


  • Role: Software Developer (Senior C++ Developer Distributed Messaging & Networking)
  • Location: Gurugram, Bengaluru
  • Experience: 8 to 12 Years
  • Job Type: Full Time Employment

What You'll Do:


  • Design, develop, and maintain a unified Pub/Sub abstraction layer supporting multiple backends including ZeroMQ, Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, and Redis.
  • Build and enhance high-performance distributed messaging components used across the analytics platform.
  • Maintain and evolve Java and Python bindings for the core C++ library while ensuring API consistency across languages.
  • Design and implement scalable service discovery mechanisms using DNS-based endpoint resolution and REST APIs.
  • Develop partition assignment and message routing strategies for Kubernetes-based deployments.
  • Optimize performance-critical components including lock-free data structures, ring buffers, time-reorder queues, and thread affinity management.
  • Implement and maintain compression capabilities using ZSTD and related technologies.
  • Manage Redis and Redis Cluster integrations including connection management, protocol handling, and operational monitoring.
  • Develop and support REST server and client components along with OpenAPI-based code generation frameworks.
  • Define, maintain, and evolve Protocol Buffer schemas while ensuring backward and forward compatibility.
  • Develop and maintain traffic filtering and event processing frameworks for efficient data delivery.
  • Write comprehensive unit, integration, and performance tests across C++, Java, and Python ecosystems.
  • Troubleshoot complex distributed system issues involving networking, messaging, performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Collaborate closely with platform consumers, architects, and engineering teams to evolve APIs and platform capabilities.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, and technical documentation activities.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing practices, and release management processes.

Expertise You'll Bring:


  • 8-12 years of software development experience with strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later).
  • Extensive experience designing and maintaining reusable libraries, SDKs, or platform components.
  • Strong understanding of memory management, smart pointers, RAII, ABI stability, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with multithreading, concurrency, atomic operations, and lock-free programming techniques.
  • Strong knowledge of STL containers, algorithms, and modern C++ design principles.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed messaging technologies such as Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, ZeroMQ, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of Pub/Sub architectures, consumer groups, partitioning, message ordering, and fault tolerance.
  • Experience with high-throughput and low-latency messaging systems.
  • Strong networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, load balancing, and distributed communication protocols.
  • Experience with Redis and Redis Cluster architectures and messaging patterns.
  • Experience building and maintaining Java integrations using JNA or JNI.
  • Experience working with Python bindings through pybind11, ctypes, cffi, SWIG, or related frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of cross-language interoperability and memory lifecycle management.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Protocol Buffers including schema design and version management.
  • Experience implementing serialization strategies for distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of compression technologies such as ZSTD and dictionary-based compression techniques.
  • Experience working with Docker-based deployments and containerized applications.
  • Strong knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated build and release processes.
  • Understanding of Kubernetes deployment models and distributed application architecture.
  • Familiarity with Helm charts and infrastructure automation practices.
  • Experience with build tools such as Make, Conan, Maven, and Python package management.
  • Strong understanding of scalable distributed system architecture.
  • Experience designing highly available and fault-tolerant platform services.
  • Ability to balance performance, reliability, maintainability, and scalability considerations.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with cross-functional engineering teams.

Job Purpose


The Senior Software Engineer (Salesforce) role exists to drive the development, integration, administration, and support of our Salesforce Wheels org and associated applications. The position is vital for ensuring system reliability, enabling effective business processes for loan origination and underwriting, supporting multiple business teams, and delivering strategic technology projects to help Bajaj Finance achieve its business goals efficiently.

Duties and Responsibilities


Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead the design, development, customization, and integration of Salesforce CRM and allied business-critical applications, including loan origination and underwriting systems, to achieve desired functionality and efficiency for business operations.
  • Ensure the stability, availability, and optimal performance of the Salesforce platform by proactively monitoring system health, troubleshooting issues, and minimizing potential business disruptions.
  • Coordinate effectively with internal cross-functional teams and external partners to drive the timely completion of project milestones, oversee change management processes, and ensure all deliverables align with organizational standards.
  • Provide advanced technical support (Tier 2 and Tier 3), handle incident management, and implement permanent resolutions for recurring issues to enhance the end-user experience.
  • Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date documentation, including support processes, user guides, training materials, and knowledge base articles, to aid user enablement and knowledge transfer.
  • Oversee and implement system integrations between Salesforce and other business-critical systems using industry-standard APIs (SOAP/REST), thus supporting data integrity and seamless process flows.
  • Uphold governance by tracking delivery schedules, managing change processes, and providing regular status reports to relevant stakeholders.


    • Key Decisions / Dimensions


  • Selection of appropriate technical approaches and programming methodologies (including choice of Java/Apex patterns, integration strategies, and API usage) for developing and enhancing Salesforce and related business applications.
  • Prioritization and scheduling of development tasks, support activities, and incident resolution to ensure alignment with project timelines and business priorities.
  • Evaluation and implementation of integration techniques to connect Salesforce with other platforms (e.g., Portals, EDW, mobile applications) while ensuring data consistency and system reliability.
  • Identification and application of best practices for change management, version control, and deployment within the Salesforce ecosystem, in alignment with DevOps and ITIL principles.
  • Determination of root cause solutions for recurring system issues, including whether to implement temporary workarounds or permanent fixes, while balancing risk and impact.
  • Decisions regarding escalation or resolution of complex incidents and service requests, including coordination with cross-functional teams and external partners as appropriate.
  • Selection and preparation of documentation, training materials, and user guides to maximize knowledge transfer and facilitate user adoption.
  • Assessment of technological advancements and recommendations for adoption of relevant new tools, frameworks, or practices to support ongoing platform improvements.


    • Major Challenges


  • Ensuring seamless integration of Salesforce CRM with diverse external and internal systems (such as portals, enterprise data warehouses, and mobile applications) while maintaining data integrity and system performance.
  • Managing platform enhancements and multiple ongoing projects simultaneously, including the definition, execution, and timely delivery of project milestones within stringent deadlines.
  • Addressing complex technical issues and resolving recurring incidents quickly to minimize downtime and maintain business continuity in a fast-paced financial services environment.
  • Balancing the need for rapid delivery of new features and enhancements with stringent quality standards and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Coordinating effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners to align IT initiatives with evolving business requirements, while managing stakeholder expectations.
  • Maintaining comprehensive documentation and knowledge bases despite frequent changes and updates in business processes and technology.
  • Adapting to advancements in Salesforce technology, system integrations, and DevOps practices, and ensuring continuous skill development for sustained platform excellence.


    • Required Qualifications and Experience


    a)Qualifications
    Bachelor''s / masters degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. Experience in Manual and Automation Testing.
    b)Work Experience

    3+ years of experience in a Salesforce Admin/Developer role within a technology or IT organization.

    Skills and Knowledge
  • Strong proficiency in Java and Apex programming languages, with hands-on experience in object-oriented programming and development on the Salesforce platform.
  • In-depth understanding of Salesforce architecture, including configuration, customization, workflows, and security models.
  • Practical experience with Salesforce APIs (SOAP/RESTful) for system integrations with internal and external platforms such as portals, data warehouses, and mobile applications.
  • Demonstrated capability in project management: defining milestones, managing delivery schedules, monitoring progress, and facilitating status reporting.
  • Proficient in Salesforce administration, platform health monitoring, incident management, and providing Tier 2 and Tier 3 technical support.
  • Strong analytical and diagnostic skills for troubleshooting system issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing permanent resolutions.
  • Ability to document technical solutions, support processes, and create training materials and user guides for varied stakeholders.
  • Sound understanding of the loan business lifecycle, financial processes, and the operational requirements of a financial services organization. (Good to have)
  • Basic knowledge of database systems and data management principles.
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and frameworks for change management, service delivery, and IT governance.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices related to Salesforce, including automated deployments, version control, and continuous integration.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Sales, Marketing) and managing relationships with external technology partners.

We are looking for an experienced C++ Developer to join our platform engineering team and own the shared distributed messaging and networking library that serves as the communication backbone of our analytics platform. This highly scalable library enables seamless communication between packet capture, protocol analysis, decryption, and downstream processing systems with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability.


  • Role: Software Developer
  • Location: Gurugram, Bengaluru
  • Experience: 12 to 15 Years
  • Job Type: Full Time Employment

What You'll Do:


  • Design, develop, and maintain a unified Pub/Sub abstraction layer supporting multiple backends including ZeroMQ, Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, and Redis.
  • Build and enhance high-performance distributed messaging components used across the analytics platform.
  • Maintain and evolve Java and Python bindings for the core C++ library while ensuring API consistency across languages.
  • Design and implement scalable service discovery mechanisms using DNS-based endpoint resolution and REST APIs.
  • Develop partition assignment and message routing strategies for Kubernetes-based deployments.
  • Optimize performance-critical components including lock-free data structures, ring buffers, time-reorder queues, and thread affinity management.
  • Implement and maintain compression capabilities using ZSTD and related technologies.
  • Manage Redis and Redis Cluster integrations including connection management, protocol handling, and operational monitoring.
  • Develop and support REST server and client components along with OpenAPI-based code generation frameworks.
  • Define, maintain, and evolve Protocol Buffer schemas while ensuring backward and forward compatibility.
  • Develop and maintain traffic filtering and event processing frameworks for efficient data delivery.
  • Write comprehensive unit, integration, and performance tests across C++, Java, and Python ecosystems.
  • Troubleshoot complex distributed system issues involving networking, messaging, performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Collaborate closely with platform consumers, architects, and engineering teams to evolve APIs and platform capabilities.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, and technical documentation activities.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing practices, and release management processes.

Expertise You'll Bring:


  • 12-15 years of software development experience with strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later).
  • Extensive experience designing and maintaining reusable libraries, SDKs, or platform components.
  • Strong understanding of memory management, smart pointers, RAII, ABI stability, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with multithreading, concurrency, atomic operations, and lock-free programming techniques.
  • Strong knowledge of STL containers, algorithms, and modern C++ design principles. 
  • Hands-on experience with distributed messaging technologies such as Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, ZeroMQ, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of Pub/Sub architectures, consumer groups, partitioning, message ordering, and fault tolerance.
  • Experience with high-throughput and low-latency messaging systems.
  • Strong networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, load balancing, and distributed communication protocols.
  • Experience with Redis and Redis Cluster architectures and messaging patterns.
  • Experience building and maintaining Java integrations using JNA or JNI.
  • Experience working with Python bindings through pybind11, ctypes, cffi, SWIG, or related frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of cross-language interoperability and memory lifecycle management.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Protocol Buffers including schema design and version management.
  • Experience implementing serialization strategies for distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of compression technologies such as ZSTD and dictionary-based compression techniques.
  • Experience working with Docker-based deployments and containerized applications.
  • Strong knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated build and release processes.
  • Understanding of Kubernetes deployment models and distributed application architecture.
  • Familiarity with Helm charts and infrastructure automation practices.
  • Experience with build tools such as Make, Conan, Maven, and Python package management.
  • Strong understanding of scalable distributed system architecture.
  • Experience designing highly available and fault-tolerant platform services.
  • Ability to balance performance, reliability, maintainability, and scalability considerations.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with cross-functional engineering teams.

The role Allerin builds AI and IoT products. Edge to cloud video intelligence, computer vision systems, and data platforms. We also build and run software for clients who measure whether it works. You will see both.
You will not be given a toy project. Within the training you work on real tickets in real codebases, and your code is reviewed properly, line by line, by people whose job is to make you better at this. Most of what you learn in the first 3 months will not be a language or a framework. It will be how to read a codebase you did not write, how to tell when you are stuck, and how to finish something.


What the 3 months look like
  • Reading before writing. You start in an existing codebase, because that is what the job actually is.
  • Real tickets, reviewed hard. Small pieces of real work, with review that tells you what is wrong and why.
  • Learning to ask. Knowing when to spend another hour and when to put your hand up is a skill, and we teach it deliberately.
  • Shipping something. By the end you will have written code that is running.


What you must arrive with
We do not require a particular degree and we are not filtering on your college.
  • You can already program in something. Which language matters much less than whether you can build a small thing that works.
  • You have built something of your own, however rough, and you can talk about it. See the GitHub requirement below.
  • You can read code you did not write without giving up in the first ten minutes.
  • You write clearly enough to explain what you did and where you got stuck.
  • You finished your education within roughly the last 12 months, or you are about to.

Job Description: MIS Executive (South Cluster)

Role Overview

We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented MIS Executive to manage data reporting for our South Cluster. In this role, you won't just move numbers aroundyou will build the tools and reports that help our leadership team make the right decisions. We need someone who is fast, technically skilled, and obsessed with accuracy.

Excel Mastery (The "Power User")

You don’t just "use" Excel; you command it. We need someone who can build robust, scalable workbooks that don't break when a new row is added.

  • Advanced Logic: Proficient in complex formulas (XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Let/Lambda functions).
  • Dynamic Reporting: Expert-level use of Pivot Tables and Power Query to transform and automate data cleanup.
  • Data Structuring: An intuitive understanding of how to organize data for long-term usability.

SQL & Database Fluency

You are comfortable communicating directly with our databases to get the answers you need.

  • Query Writing: Ability to write clean, efficient SQL to extract, join, and filter data from multiple tables.
  • Data Integrity: Knowledge of how to validate source data to ensure your "pull" matches reality.

Data Visualization (Power BI / Tableau / Looker)

Data is only useful if people understand it. You should have a grasp of at least one major BI tool (preferably Power BI).

  • Dashboard Design: Ability to turn complex datasets into intuitive, visual stories.
  • Metric Definition: Experience building DAX measures or calculated fields that reflect business KPIs accurately.

AI-Augmented Productivity

We value efficiency over "doing it the hard way." You should be an early adopter of AI tools to enhance your workflow.

  • Prompt Engineering: Using LLMs (like ChatGPT or Gemini) to troubleshoot code, write complex Regex, or brainstorm data models.
  • Automation Mindset: Leveraging AI to speed up repetitive tasks, from drafting documentation to refactoring SQL queries.

Radical Attention to Detail

You are your own toughest critic. You treat every stakeholder report as a reflection of your professional brand.

  • Error Detection: You proactively catch "silent errors" (like duplicates or null values) before they reach the final presentation.
  • The "Sanity Check": You always ask, "Does this number actually make sense?" before hitting send.

Why Join Us?

You will play a key role in how our South Cluster operates. If you enjoy solving problems with data and take pride in producing "perfect" reports, you’ll fit right in.

- Data Querying: Advanced SQL (Window functions, CTEs, Query optimization)

What Makes You a Great Fit

- Storytelling: You can take a messy spreadsheet and turn it into a compelling 3-slide deck for executives.

  • Prepare clean, well-documented, context-rich datasets that Data Science and AI/Copilot use cases can safely rely on. Assets should be future and AI ready for conversational analytics.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and architects to design and implement efficient data pipelines in the Databricks platform. Work hand-in-hand with Reporting/BI and Data Science teams – supporting them without duplicating their work.

  • Advanced SQL – window functions, CTEs, complex joins, reconciliation and performance-aware querying.
  • Solid Python / PySpark skills for profiling, cleansing, enrichment and large-scale transformation.

Role Summary

The Data Analyst will be responsible for translating the Groups data - spanning customer/stakeholder data (Teachers, Schools, Retailers, Distributors, Vendors, Partners) and factory operations data (production, dispatch, inventory, material movement) - into actionable business insights. The role owns dashboard and report development across CRM and ERP systems, surfacing coverage metrics, campaign engagement, operational efficiency, data health scores, and compliance status for SBU heads, plant leadership, and senior management.

The position works closely with the Data Management Lead, Governance Lead, Marketing Automation Lead, and SBU stakeholders to ensure data is structured, accurate, and presented in a way that drives decision-making across the organisation.


Key Responsibilities


Dashboard & Reporting

  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports (Power BI / Looker Studio / equivalent BI tools) covering coverage metrics, campaign engagement, operational performance, data health, and compliance status across customer and factory datasets.
  • Translate raw CRM, ERP, and factory operations data into business-ready KPI views for SBU heads, plant leadership, and senior management.
  • Build and maintain a Master Dashboard consolidating departmental views into a single navigation hub for organisation-wide visibility.
  • Apply DAX, Power Query, and data modelling best practices (star schema, row-level security) to ensure dashboards are scalable, secure, and performant.

Data Analysis & Insights

  • Conduct customer/stakeholder segmentation analysis across Teachers, Schools, Retailers, Distributors, Vendors, and Partners to identify trends, inactivity, and engagement patterns; present findings and recommendations to leadership.
  • Analyse factory operations data - production output, dispatch, material movement, and inventory - to identify inefficiencies, optimisation opportunities, and cost-saving areas (e.g. slow-moving stock, process bottlenecks, vendor price variations).
  • Sanitise and centralise data from disparate CRM, ERP, and factory systems into a single, governed source of truth - ensuring consistent definitions, eliminating duplicate/conflicting records, and enabling unified reporting across the organisation.
  • Perform data cleansing, deduplication, and validation across CRM, ERP, and factory systems to maintain data quality and integrity.
  • Conduct exploratory and variance analysis to flag anomalies, policy violations, or process gaps for resolution by the relevant function (Data Management Lead, Governance Lead, SBU teams, or plant operations).
  • Support ad-hoc analytical requests from SBU heads, plant leadership, and senior management with quick-turnaround data pulls and visualisations.

Data Integration & ETL

  • Build and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, cleanse, and load data from CRM, ERP, marketing automation, and factory operations systems into reporting tools.
  • Maintain unique key mapping and data integration logic across systems to eliminate data silos and ensure a single source of truth for stakeholder data.
  • Coordinate with the Data Management Lead on data quality rules, validity standards, and master data structure to ensure reporting reflects the governed data model.

Stakeholder Support & Coordination

  • Gather reporting requirements from SBU heads, departmental teams, and leadership; translate business questions into dashboard and KPI specifications.
  • Support the Marketing Automation Lead with campaign performance reporting and ROI analysis across WhatsApp, email, and SMS channels.
  • Document dashboard logic, data definitions, and reporting SOPs to ensure consistency and ease of handover.
  • Train SBU users on self-service dashboard usage where applicable.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Dashboard Coverage & Adoption: Core KPI dashboards live and actively used by SBU heads and plant leadership; usage/adoption tracked monthly.
  • Reporting Turnaround: Standard reports delivered on defined refresh cycles; ad-hoc analytical requests turned around within agreed SLA.
  • Data Quality & Accuracy: Data health score maintained above target threshold across CRM, ERP, and factory datasets; duplicate/erroneous records identified and flagged for correction.
  • Operational Insights Delivered: Number and impact of actionable insights surfaced (e.g. inventory optimisation, cost savings, process inefficiencies identified) and adopted by business/plant teams.
  • Customer/Stakeholder Insights Delivered: Segmentation and engagement analyses delivered on schedule, with measurable follow-through on recommendations (e.g. re-engagement campaigns, coverage improvement).
  • Automation Impact: Manual reporting effort reduced through automation of recurring reports/alerts, tracked as hours saved.

  • MBA or equivalent specialisation in Business Analytics / Data Science is an advantage
  • Relevant certifications preferred:
  • Power BI / Power BI Developer
  • SQL / MySQL
  • Python for Data Analysis

Required Skills

  • Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Data Modelling, RLS, Incremental Refresh)
  • SQL / MySQL
  • Google Looker Studio and/or other BI/analytics platforms
  • Working knowledge of Python (Pandas, NumPy) for data analysis and automation

  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across SBUs and translate business requirements into reporting solutions
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to data accuracy and detail

Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to design, develop, and deliver actionable analytics for a cloud-native US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) platform. This role focuses on data analysis, BI, dashboards, automation, and reporting across Claims, Prior Authorization, Scheduling, Coding, Collections, Payments, Denials, AR, and EDI. Data Analysis Reporting

  • Prepare stakeholder-ready PowerPoint presentations and Word documentation summarizing trends and insights.

AI/ML Automation Enablement

RCM EDI Analytics

Collaboration Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with Product Managers, Operations, Finance, and AI/ML teams to align analytics with business goals.
  • Support self-service analytics adoption for operational and management teams.
  • Communicate insights effectively using data storytelling, dashboards, and presentations.

Data Governance Compliance

  • Implement role-based access controls (RBAC), PHI masking, and audit-ready reporting.
  • Document data sources, metrics definitions, and reporting logic to maintain traceability.

Collaborate closely with both IT teams and business stakeholders to gather requirements, validate data, and resolve data quality issues.

Document all data processes, methodologies, and insights clearly and effectively for a variety of audiences.

About Mechademy Mechademy builds an enterprise AI platform for real-time monitoring, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance of industrial equipment. We are a venture-funded, Series A startup experiencing 8090% YoY growth, with 15+ enterprise clients across oil & gas, power generation, and LNG.


The Opportunity We are looking for a sharp Data Analyst who thrives on open-ended problem-solving. Instead of answering pre-packaged questions or staring at standing dashboards, you will be handed raw data and complex industrial datasets (sensor streams across speed, pressure, temperature, flow, and vibration) to figure out what is actually happening. Your findings will directly inform engineers making decisions on assets worth hundreds of millions of dollars.


What You'll Own

  • Investigation & Root Cause (40%): Pull and structure raw sensor data across time windows, formulate testable hypotheses, and work alongside domain engineers to trace anomalies from raw signals to defensible recommendations.
  • Performance & Efficiency (25%): Analyze relationships between operating variables, build before/after intervention studies, and derive performance metrics to quantify asset degradation or improvement.
  • Reporting & Communication (15%): Produce clear visualizations, structured analytical reports, and summaries that stand up to leadership scrutiny.
  • Product Analytics (10%): Analyze internal user interactions and platform usage metrics to help improve the Mechademy product itself.
  • Knowledge & Reuse (10%): Document analytical patterns and help build a shared knowledge base of equipment behavior and reusable frameworks.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

  • Structured Problem-Solving: Ability to break down vague, large-scale problems into solvable components and stitch them back into coherent answers.
  • Defensible Reasoning: Your conclusions logically follow from your analysis, and you can clearly walk senior stakeholders through your work.
  • Python Proficiency: Daily comfort with Python (pandas, numpy, and basic scipy for statistical checks) as a core analytical tool.
  • Time-Series Experience: Comfort working with sequential data indexed over time, spotting trends, seasonality, and drift.
  • Hypothesis-Driven Mindset: A natural reflex to form testable explanations when encountering anomalies rather than random searching.
  • Comfort with Ambiguity: Ability to take a vague prompt and turn it into a rigorous, structured investigation.

Strong Signals

  • Exposure to real equipment, IoT, SCADA, or industrial sensor streams.
  • Curiosity about product and user behavior analytics.
  • Engineering, science, or quantitative academic background.

What We Offer

  • Direct access to irreplaceable operational sensor data from enterprise clients.
  • Close collaboration with domain engineers and AI-powered investigation tooling.
  • A fast learning curve, high impact, and clear growth path early in your career.
  • Competitive compensation and hybrid flexibility (23 days on-site in Gurugram).

Summary:


  • Role type : Contractor
  • Engagement window: Full-time during the base-brain build (Aug-Dec) fractional ongoing (Jan-Apr)
  • Location: Tier-1 India (Bangalore • Hyderabad • Chennai • Pune • Mumbai • Delhi NCR); remote-friendly
  • Reports to : CTO
  • Team : Likely a lead Data Analyst + AI, scaling to a small pool for the global expansion

About the role


The Data Analyst is the primary resource who marshals the documentation that builds the platform's base Brain. The Brain produces a credible screening PCF by ontological equivalence estimating a supplier's missing data from comparable suppliers (same material process country). That only works once a reference base (~1,500 suppliers) populates the equivalence space. Building that base is what makes meaningful output possible for any customer so this role is foundational and on the critical path.

The platform serves automotive OEMs and their Tier-1 suppliers, whose supplier base is global so the base you build is global and multi-language, not India-only. You will not do this alone or by hand: you work AI-first (Claude to extract, translate and structure across languages) on the pipeline the AI/ML Platform Engineer builds, and the base is built coverage-first EU + India (the high-yield, high-relevance regions) first for general audience, then China / SE Asia / Americas as expansion. You run the ingestion; you do not build it.


Key responsibilities


Source & marshal the documentation (global)


  • Global sources EU company registers + CSRD-cascade disclosures, national registries, OEM / Tier-1 supplier portals, India (BRSR / MCA), Japan / Korea filings, industry associations and global databases per the approved-source registry.
  • Multi-language, AI-first — use Claude to extract, translate and structure non-English sources at scale; you curate and QA, the AI does the volume.
  • IP discipline — ingest derived attributes only; never redistribute source documents; every field carries a source and confidence tier (A/B/C).

Build the base — coverage-first


  • EU + India first — build coverage of the equivalence neighbourhoods (material process country) for OEM/Tier-1 suppliers in the high-yield regions first, so the platform can ride on a covered sub-footprint.
  • Default-anchor the hard regions — where public data is sparse (China, SE Asia, N. Africa), anchor with regional / sector defaults + a few representative suppliers rather than fully sourcing each; improve as primary data arrives.
  • Structure & resolve — normalize into the L2 schema; resolve entity-resolution and source-format exceptions; one canonical profile per supplier.

Quality, provenance & drift


  • QA against the golden set — check profiles within tolerance; triage and flag gap-fills; keep provenance + tier on every field.
  • Monitor drift — watch source-format changes across regions; keep the source registry current.

What success looks like — coverage-driven phasing


  • Foundation (10) — taxonomy, ingest contract, entity-ID and gates frozen; per-region automated yield measured; golden set seeded.
  • 50 — cohort model proven; EU + India yield confirmed on real cohorts.
  • ~150 — EU + India core equivalence neighborhoods started; first meaningful screening outputs.
  • ~500 (GA-ready) — EU + India covered credible screening PCFs for EU + India suppliers.
  • GA-usefulness threshold.
  • 800 1,500 (post-GA) — add China / SE Asia / Americas — multi-language, default-anchored where data is sparse.


Required qualifications


  • Data literacy — spreadsheets and SQL; some Python a plus; can structure messy source data into a defined schema.
  • Research & sourcing skill across jurisdictions — finding and extracting the right data from reports, filings and portals; strong attention to detail.
  • AI-first working — fluent using Claude and similar to extract, translate and structure at scale, with human judgement on exceptions and QA.
  • Comfort with multi-language sources (via AI translation); rigour on provenance (source • date • confidence tier).
  • Willingness to learn the carbon / LCA and automotive supply-chain domain; 2–4 years in a data / research / analyst / operations role; volume data collection & QA a strong plus.


Boundaries


  • Owns — sourcing, structuring and QA of the global base-Brain data.
  • Not this role — building the ingestion pipeline or L4 (AI/ML Platform Engineer); taxonomy / methodology governance (CTO); the programme (PM); the customer-facing product (Product Engineer).
  • Seam — operates the pipeline the AI/ML Platform Engineer builds; escalates taxonomy questions to the CTO

8-11 years

AWS Data Engineering
  • Design and build production-grade AWS data pipelines using Amazon S3, AWS Glue, PySpark, Athena, Redshift, EMR, MWAA/Airflow, Step Functions, Lambda, EventBridge, CloudWatch, IAM, and KMS.

  • Create reusable AWS platform accelerators for onboarding, pipeline templates, orchestration, monitoring, reconciliation, deployment, logging, and support runbooks.

  • Implement AWS data security controls including IAM least privilege, KMS encryption, Secrets Manager, VPC endpoints, Lake Formation, Glue Data Catalog, Macie, CloudTrail, and audit-ready access patterns.

Skills and attributes for success
Skill / capability area

Job Description:


As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining large-scale data systems and infrastructure. You will contribute to multiple projects from both operational and technical standpoints, drive architectural discussions, and guide teams on data engineering best practices. This role requires strong knowledge of data architecture, cloud platforms, data modeling, ETL/ELT, and modern data processing patterns across batch and real-time workflows.


Key Responsibilities :


• 3-12 years of relevant work experience.

• Design, store, process, and maintain large-scale data systems and related infrastructure.

• Drive multiple projects from both operational and technical standpoints.

Ideate and build PoVs/PoCs for new products that can help drive more business.

• Define, design, and implement data engineering best practices, strategies, and solutions.

• Act as an architect guiding customers, the team, and the organization on tools, technologies, and best practices in data engineering.

• Lead architecture discussions and align them with business needs, security, and best practices.

• Demonstrate strong conceptual understanding of Data Warehousing, ETL, Data Governance, Security, Cloud Computing, and Batch & Real-Time Data Processing.

• Apply strong execution knowledge of Data Modeling, SQL/NoSQL databases, SDLC practices, unit testing, and functional programming.

• Understand and work with Medallion architecture patterns. • Work on at least one major cloud platform.

• Execute multiple end-to-end data engineering projects as a data architect.

• Possess extensive knowledge of various data architecture designs and data modeling concepts.

• Manage conversations with client stakeholders, understand requirements, and translate them into technical outcomes. Required Skills and Experience

• Strong proficiency in SQL.

• Experience working with any major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• Working knowledge of ETL/orchestration tools (IICS, Talend, Matillion, Airflow, ADF, AWS Glue, GCP Composer, etc.).

• Working knowledge of OLTP databases (Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, etc.).

• Working knowledge of Data Warehouses such as Snowflake, Redshift, Azure Synapse, Hive, BigQuery, etc.

• Proficiency in at least one data engineering programming language such as Python (or Scala/Rust/Java).

• Strong execution knowledge of Data Modeling (star schema, snowflake schema, fact/dimension tables).

• Proficient in Spark and related platforms (Databricks, GCP DataProc, AWS Glue, EMR, etc.).

• Experience working with Kafka and real-time streaming.

• Strong understanding of data architecture patterns (Lambda, Kappa, data harmonization, CDP patterns, etc.).

• Experience in code and SQL optimization.

• Strong knowledge of Git and CI/CD pipeline design for continuous delivery.

• Experience with data and networking security (RBAC, secret management, key vaults, VNets/subnets, certificates). Being a Mathemagician

• Demonstrate ownership and strive for excellence in delivering results. • Actively engage and contribute to initiatives fostering company growth.

Hexaware Technologies Hiring Drive | Data Engineer | virtual drive | 29 August 2026Greetings,Hexaware Technologies is conducting a virtual Hiring Drive in bangalore on 29 August 2026 for experienced Data Engineers. We are seeking professionals with strong expertise in ETL, SQL, Python/PySpark, and Azure Databricks.Position Details

  • Role: Data Engineer
  • Experience: 4 to 6 Years
  • Location: Bangalore/hyderabad/chennai
  • Interview Mode: Virtual
  • Interview Date: 29 August 2026
  • Employment Type: Full-Time

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer with 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering, ETL development, and large-scale Data Migration projects. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Azure Data Factory (ADF), Python, PostgreSQL, SQL, and Azure Blob Storage, with proven experience in designing and implementing end-to-end data migration solutions. The role involves developing robust data ingestion pipelines, transforming and standardizing data from multiple heterogeneous sources, and ensuring seamless migration of structured and unstructured data into modern cloud-based platforms.

As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for building and managing scalable ETL workflows using Azure Data Factory and Python, extracting data from various enterprise sources such as SharePoint Lists, SharePoint Document Libraries, Excel Workbooks, XML files, and file repositories. You will design and implement transformation logic to normalize diverse tracker structures and align them with target data models while ensuring data integrity and consistency. The role requires hands-on experience in developing data cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and error-handling mechanisms to maintain high data quality standards throughout the migration lifecycle.


Key responsibilities


design, develop, and maintain data ingestion and migration pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and Python.

  • Extract and process data from SharePoint Lists, Document Libraries, Excel files, XML files, and enterprise file repositories.
  • Build and implement data transformation frameworks to standardize heterogeneous data structures and map them to target schemas.
  • Develop data quality checks, cleansing routines, validation rules, reconciliation reports, and error-handling mechanisms.
  • Create bulk-load and incremental migration solutions for large-scale data migration projects.
  • Migrate documents and attachments to Azure Blob Storage and maintain associated metadata within PostgreSQL.
  • Develop SQL scripts, stored procedures, and optimized loading strategies for PostgreSQL databases.
  • Support migration testing, UAT, reconciliation, cutover execution, and post-migration verification activities.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize ETL and migration pipeline performance.
  • Prepare technical documentation, deployment plans, migration runbooks, and operational support guides.


Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD automation.

  • Current CTC

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Databricks & Snowflake Developer with strong expertise in PySpark, Delta Lake, Snowflake SQL, and Azure Data Engineering services. The ideal candidate will design, develop, and optimize large-scale data pipelines across both Databricks and Snowflake platforms to support analytics, reporting, and enterprise data initiatives. This role requires close collaboration with data engineers, analysts, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, high quality, and cost efficient cloud data solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, optimize, and maintain Databricks notebooks, workflows, jobs, and scalable PySpark applications, including Delta Lake implementation, performance tuning, and Git-based code management.
  • Build and optimize Snowflake solutions using advanced SQL, data ingestion pipelines (Stages, File Formats, COPY, Snowpipe), and automated ELT workflows leveraging Streams, Tasks, and Materialized Views.
  • Design, develop, and enhance end-to-end ETL/ELT data pipelines across Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, and Synapse, ensuring scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
  • Integrate data from databases, APIs, file systems, and cloud platforms while aligning with enterprise data architecture, data modeling, governance, and security standards.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate data requirements into technical solutions, support BI and analytics initiatives, and deliver high-quality, cost-effective cloud data solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve Databricks, Snowflake, and ADF platform issues, perform root cause analysis, maintain documentation, and implement preventive measures to ensure reliable operations.

Technical Skills and Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in data engineering, big data development, and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, Spark SQL, and Azure Data Engineering services.
  • Strong expertise in Snowflake development, including Snowflake SQL, ELT processes, performance tuning, and warehouse optimization.
  • Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF), Synapse, ADLS, and Snowflake integration features.

  • Knowledge of data security and governance best practices, including RBAC, masking policies, and access control management.

column280:
Job Description
Come join our passionate team! Barracuda is a leading cybersecurity company providing complete protection against complex threats. Our platform protects email, data, applications, and networks with innovative solutions, and a managed XDR service, to strengthen cyber resilience. Hundreds of thousands of IT professionals and managed service providers worldwide trust us to protect and support them with solutions that are easy to buy, deploy, and use.
We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. Barracuda Networks is proud to be an employer that complies with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity regardless of race, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or disability.
Envision yourself at Barracuda:
We are looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer II to join our growing team and help us develop cutting-edge Machine Learning detection solutions for our email protection products. As part of the Efficacy engineering team, you will be responsible for designing and implementing innovative machine learning algorithms that can analyze vast amounts of data and detect threats in real-time. You will be part of a team that is responsible for detecting email threats across our customers. You possess strong technical hands-on experience in delivering use cases and detection rules for multiple attack vectors through Machine learning. You help by developing detection methods to make sure we can identify potential threats and take action to stop them. This is an excellent opportunity to work with an elite team of security engineers and make a real impact in the field of cybersecurity. You will collaborate with other team members every day. Being a team player is necessary for being successful in this role along with having an innovative and forward-facing mindset. You will be a leader within the team and act as a mentor to other team members.
What youll be working on:
  • Analyze vast amounts of data to identify threats and devise innovative algorithms to detect them in real-time
  • Research and develop new email threat detections to support the ever-changing cyber space
  • Build and train machine learning classifiers to detect attacks across our email protection products
  • Evaluate the performance of your algorithms and continuously optimize them
  • Collaborate with an elite team of machine learning and software engineers to scale your algorithms and bring them to production
  • Leverage the latest AI to accelerate delivery of detection solutions
  • Work with cutting-edge technologies in a fast-paced environment
  • Communicate clearly and effectively, both written and orally, the risks that exist and remediations required for any security incident.
  • Work collaboratively and independently on unique or special assignments which may require specialized knowledge and/or experience
What you will bring to the role:
  • Bachelors degree in computer science or electrical engineering. An advanced degree is a plus; or equivalent work experience
  • 2-4 years of experience in creating and maintaining machine learning models
  • Proven track record in developing production-grade machine learning algorithms that solve practical problems
  • 2+ years of experience in analyzing large structured and unstructured data using Python (or other relevant languages)
  • Visceral understanding of probability and supervised/unsupervised learning
  • Experience working with Databricks and SQL.
  • Hands on experience with cloud architecture such AWS or Azure is a plus.
  • Experience with Deep learning is a plus
  • Hands-on experience with MLOps tools (MLFlow) for model deployment and inference is a plus.
  • Experience with Identity Access Graph/Knowledge graphs and Graph modelling is a huge plus.
  • Experience in cybersecurity is a plus
  • Experience using AI features for model inference LLMs, RAG systems, and evaluation frameworks is a plus
  • Entrepreneurial spirit and extreme sense of ownership
  • Deep desire to make our customers happy and provide best-in-class machine learning detections
What you ll get from us:
A team where you can voice your opinion, make an impact, and where you and your experience are valued. Internal mobility - there are opportunities for cross training and the ability to attain your next career step within Barracuda.

We are seeking a skilled Machine Learning Operations Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our growing AI and Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing robust MLOps and LLMOps platforms that support the complete machine learning lifecycle, from model development to production deployment, monitoring, and optimization.

  • Drive platform improvements focused on scalability, resiliency, operational efficiency, and automation.
  • Implement best practices for model lifecycle management, versioning, governance, and auditability.

  • Experience supporting production AI/ML platforms and mission-critical workloads.
  • Knowledge of model versioning, experiment tracking, model registry, and governance frameworks.

  • Strong understanding of security, compliance, and responsible AI practices.
  • Experience with performance benchmarking, model evaluation, and optimization techniques.
  • Hands-on expertise with automation frameworks and infrastructure management.
  • Strong programming experience in Python and automation scripting.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Understanding of CI/CD practices, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps methodologies.
  • Experience deploying and managing RAG-based and Agentic AI applications.
  • Knowledge of multimodal AI workflows and Large Language Models.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced and dynamic enterprise environments.

Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production - we ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
Role Overview & Key Responsibilities
This is a high-leverage leadership role that spans architecture, execution, and org-building, and will shape the direction of our AI / ML initiatives at Ema. We are seeking an AI / ML technical leader who can take a vision and build it. As a Principal ML Engineer at Ema, you will be a senior technical leader responsible for shaping the machine learning roadmap, architecting large-scale ML systems, driving innovation, and ensuring our mixture of expert models (LLM + SLM + Custom Model) is accurate and performant at scale. You will collaborate across teams (research, product, infra, data, etc.), mentor senior engineers, and influence strategy and execution at company-wide levels.
Responsibilities
  • Lead the technical direction of GenAI and agentic ML systems that power enterprise-grade AI agents - spanning reasoning, retrieval, tool use, and integrations across various SaaS products.
  • Architect, design, and implement scalable production pipelines for model training, fine-tuning, retrieval (RAG), agent orchestration, and evaluation - ensuring robustness, latency efficiency, and continuous learning.
  • Define and own the multi-year ML roadmap for GenAI infrastructure - including agent frameworks, RAG systems, world-class evaluation loops, and integration with MCP, browser, and vision pipelines.
  • Identify and integrate cutting-edge ML methods / research (deep learning, large models, recommender systems, LLMs, etc.) into Ema s products or infrastructure.
  • Research, prototype, and integrate cutting-edge ML and LLM advancements (reasoning, memory architectures, multi-modal perception, long-context models, autonomous agents) into the platform.
  • Optimize trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, interpretability, and real-world reliability across the agent lifecycle - from prompt design to orchestration and execution.
  • Champion engineering excellence - drive observability, reproducibility, versioning, testing, and bias-aware development across ML and agentic systems.
  • Mentor and elevate senior engineers and researchers, fostering a culture of scientific rigor, experimentation, and system-level thinking.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, infra, and research teams to align ML innovation with enterprise needs - enabling secure integrations, privacy-aware deployments, and scalable use cases.
  • Influence data strategy - guide how retrieval indices, embeddings, structured/unstructured corpora, and feedback loops evolve to improve grounding, factuality, and reasoning depth.
  • Drive system scalability and performance - ensuring ML agents and RAG pipelines can operate across billions of knowledge objects, diverse APIs, and real-time enterprise contexts.
Required Skills & Qualifications

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are seeking a Principal Machine Learning Engineer to join the Forecasting team within the AI & Data Science organization. As a principal technical leader, this role will set technical direction and design, build, deploy, and scale enterprise-grade machine learning, large language model, and agentic AI systems that power forecasting capabilities, uncertainty-aware decision support, scenario planning, and operational decision automation across Amgen.
This role blends deep machine learning engineering expertise, modern AI systems architecture, and product-minded delivery. The Principal Machine Learning Engineer will solve highly ambiguous problems, identify high-impact automation opportunities, and translate advanced forecasting, predictive analytics, LLM-powered applications, and AI agent patterns into reliable, governed production solutions that support critical business processes and help Amgen deliver on its "every patient, every time" mandate.
The role is well suited to a hands-on technical leader who has shipped mission-critical AI/ML systems to production, understands the practical challenges of MLOps, and can operate effectively across engineering, data science, product, operations, commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, and senior stakeholder groups.
ABOUT THE TEAM
The Forecasting team within AI & Data Science is a cross-functional team focused on building AI-native forecasting, simulation, and decision-support capabilities for Amgen. The team partners closely with business, operations, and scientific stakeholders to understand enduring planning challenges, prototype solutions quickly, measure impact rigorously, and deploy reliable systems that inform real business decisions.
Our charter is to identify high-value forecasting and decision automation opportunities, build scalable AI/ML products that can support them reliably, and continuously improve these systems based on real-world performance, user adoption, forecast quality, and measurable business value.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Define and drive the technical strategy for enterprise forecasting and AI decision systems, aligning architecture, reusable platforms, and delivery roadmaps to Amgen''s planning, supply, commercial, manufacturing, operations, and patient-focused priorities.
  • Partner with data scientists, product and program leaders, operations, commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and other business stakeholders to translate ambiguous requirements into shipped software and measurable business outcomes.
  • Architect, build, and scale production ML, LLM, and agentic AI systems that combine forecasting, predictive analytics, simulation, optimization, and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflow automation.
  • Productionize advanced statistical, Bayesian, deep learning, and machine learning models, including training, validation, inference, serving, evaluation, lifecycle management, and governed deployment.
  • Lead development of AI agent components that automate complex forecasting and operational workflows across multiple systems, decision points, datasets, and user groups while preserving appropriate human-in-the-loop review and escalation patterns.
  • Design secure integrations across enterprise APIs, databases, analytics platforms, workflow systems, cloud services, and AI orchestration patterns to enable multi-system decision support and scalable automation.
  • Establish robust MLOps and AI engineering capabilities, including model versioning, CI/CD, automated retraining, performance monitoring, observability, drift detection, service-level reliability, rollback strategies, and operational runbooks.
  • Implement guardrails, model and agent evaluation frameworks, auditability, explainability, responsible AI controls, and human-in-the-loop operating models for production AI systems in high-impact and regulated business contexts.
  • Research and evaluate state-of-the-art open-source, vendor, and internal tools related to forecasting, LLMs, AI agents, MLOps, model optimization, model serving, and scalable AI infrastructure for potential application to Amgen business problems.
  • Provide principal-level technical mentorship, design review leadership, and engineering standard-setting across teams, promoting code quality, documentation, reproducibility, testing, security, privacy, maintainability, and operational excellence.
  • Influence AI & Data Science technical and product roadmaps by identifying reusable patterns, platform opportunities, and enterprise-wide automation opportunities that accelerate Amgen''s ability to serve patients.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
  • Degree and 12+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, software engineering, data science engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional experience building, deploying, and operating production ML, AI, data, or software systems, including significant experience as a technical lead on complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated track record of designing or architecting new and existing systems with emphasis on reliability, scale, security, maintainability, and operational excellence.
  • Deep hands-on experience with the full ML engineering lifecycle, including data pipelines, feature engineering, experimentation, model training, model integration, testing, deployment, monitoring, evaluation, observability, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong experience deploying forecasting, probabilistic, Bayesian, predictive, NLP, deep learning, or LLM-based systems in production environments.
  • Experience building or integrating AI systems, including LLM-powered applications, agentic workflows, retrieval or information-retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop review patterns.
  • Strong object-oriented programming skills in Python and SQL, with experience using modern ML and software development frameworks such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow/JAX, Spark, Ray, MLflow, Airflow/Prefect/Dagster, FastAPI, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and distributed systems, including containerization, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, model serving, workflow orchestration, batch and streaming data processing, and production support.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, architecture trade-off analysis, testing strategies, code reviews, source control, build and release processes, performance optimization, and maintainability.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate technical strategy, system tradeoffs, and delivery risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders, product/program owners, scientists, and business partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, define technical direction, mentor others, and deliver measurable business value in a matrixed enterprise environment.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience building and deploying forecasting, demand planning, supply chain, manufacturing, commercial analytics, or operations decision-support systems in biotech, pharma, healthcare, retail, consumer goods, or other complex regulated or operational environments.
  • Knowledge of healthcare commercial concepts such as payer/provider dynamics, formulary access, coverage, patient access, channel dynamics, and product lifecycle considerations.

  • Experience influencing enterprise technical standards, architecture roadmaps, reusable platform capabilities, or engineering communities of practice.
  • Publications, patents, open-source contributions, conference presentations, or other evidence of thought leadership in machine learning engineering, forecasting, LLMs, AI systems, MLOps, or decision intelligence.
