THE COMPANY

Careerminds is a leader in career transition and coaching solutions, helping organizations support employees through change while enabling workforce growth and development. Our product portfolio includes market-leading Career Transition and Coaching Services as well as Progression, our application for Career Frameworks and progression planning.

THE ROLE

Were growing our machine learning team. Were looking for Machine Learning Engineers who own products end to end - from the problem, to production, to the metric that proves it worked.

This role exists because of how we build. A small product strategy team sets direction and priorities; engineers own the work end to end - discovery, design, build, ship, and the result. Youll have the autonomy of a founder inside your domain and the accountability that comes with it.

That accountability includes the unglamorous half of ML. You own the experiment that doesnt pan out and the call to kill it, not just the launch. Wed rather you run four honest experiments and ship the one that works than ship four things that all look fine on a dashboard.

AI-native development isnt an aspiration here - its the baseline. Our engineers ship with Claude Code and Claude Design as their default tools, and the leverage that creates is why one engineer can own a product end to end.

We want people already working this way who want to push the ceiling higher, not people who are curious about AI. In the interview well ask you to show us the trail: repos, PRs, or shipped work you built this way.

This is a 100% remote/work-from-home role.

THE KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Depending on area of focus:

Canonical data and entity resolution

  • Canonical datasets for titles, companies, skills, and industries - the layer every application depends on. Content-addressed IDs, faceted taxonomies, alias graphs accumulated across tens of millions of rows.
  • Rules-based resolution pipelines with LLM escalation, where the accumulated alias graph is the durable asset and escalation volume should fall over time.
  • Nightly agent loops that adjudicate ambiguous entities, propose structural changes, and get gated by invariant checks and blast-radius limits before anything commits.
  • Job ingestion at scale: multi-source feeds, deduplication, freshness, and the indexing economics underneath.

Retrieval, ranking, and matching

  • Job matching v2: two-tower retrieval with cross-encoder reranking, trained on outcome labels rather than clicks. Hard-negative mining, propensity weighting, impression-time logging.
  • Mobility embeddings learned from observed career sequences - the similarity a text encoder cant recover, where Claims Adjuster and Underwriting Assistant are substitutable despite sharing no vocabulary.
  • Pivot feasibility: given where someone is, what moves are realistic, whats missing, and which intermediate roles actually worked for peers.

Applied LLMs and agents

  • Fine-tuning where it earns its cost - against outcome labels, not for tasks a well-prompted frontier model already handles.
  • Agentic systems in production with human approval gates: agents that analyze, propose changes as reviewable artifacts, and execute only after a human signs off. We have this pattern running against tens of millions of customer touchpoints a year and want to push it much further.
  • Continuous skills inference from work artifacts rather than static documents - a problem several of our enterprise customers are currently solving for themselves, badly.
  • New product surfaces where the right answer genuinely requires an LLM, and the discipline to notice when it doesnt.

Across all of it

  • Evaluation infrastructure youd defend in a design review: time-forward splits, calibration, offline-to-online agreement, and honest handling of feedback-loop degeneration and survivorship bias.
  • Building inside real constraints: GDPR, EU AI Act high-risk classification for employment AI, and client data commitments are design inputs here, not someone elses problem.

THE MUST-HAVES

  • 5+ years shipping ML systems into production - and you can name the system, the metric before and after, and how you knew the model caused the change.
  • Depth in both classical ML and deep learning (PyTorch or TensorFlow) applied to live products, not notebooks and Kaggle sets.
  • Working fluency with LLMs in production - retrieval, evals, prompt and context engineering, and the judgment to recognize when an LLM is the wrong tool.
  • You already ship with agentic coding tools - Claude Code, Claude Design, or close equivalents - and can point to work you built with them.
  • Software engineering fundamentals strong enough to own your own deploys - Python, Git, cloud (we run AWS), containers, and the patience for genuinely messy, human-authored, self-reported data.

THE NICE-TO-HAVES

  • Entity resolution, record linkage, or taxonomy design at scale
  • Ranking, recommendation, or two-tower retrieval systems
  • Sequence models on longitudinal or event-stream data
  • Embedding and vector retrieval systems in production
  • Experiment design, causal inference, or off-policy evaluation
  • Warehouse-native ML (dbt, Snowflake, or similar)
  • Labor market, HR tech, or people-data domain experience

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team:

The EG Advertising Platform ML Engineering team builds and operates the machine learning systems that power TravelAds, Expedia Group s performance advertising marketplace, generating over $1.3B in annual revenue. The platform processes about 128 million daily requests at 99.9% availability with 25 45ms latency, ranking and scoring ads across BEX, HCOM, and Package contexts.

We are investing in automation, orchestration, and AI-assisted workflows to improve how ML models move from idea to production and to reduce cycle time across the ML lifecycle. This role is a strong fit for an engineer who wants to build reliable ML systems, improve operational quality, and contribute to production ML at meaningful scale.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, resilient, and secure machine learning services and components that power Expedia Group products and platforms.

  • Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, architects, and other engineers to translate business and customer requirements into robust ML system designs, including low-level design, API design, and data models for training and serving.

  • Implement, optimize, and productionize ML models, writing clean, maintainable, and well documented code, automated tests, and tooling that improve reliability, observability, and operational excellence for ML pipelines and services.

  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions, identifying opportunities to simplify ML systems, reduce technical debt, and improve performance, quality, and cost efficiency across multiple services or domains.

  • Own the end to end lifecycle of ML features and services, including data preparation, training, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and incremental improvement, and safely integrate and operate AI/ML enabled solutions that improve outcomes.

  • Work across different parts of the stack or adjacent domains as needed, building familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.

  • 2+ years of relevant professional experience.

  • Hands on proficiency in at least one modern programming language and its ecosystem, with experience in system design (LLD), API design, and data modeling for ML driven, service oriented, or microservices architectures.

  • Experience owning ML features or services through development, experimentation, testing, deployment, and operational support, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.

  • Solid understanding of core computer science and ML engineering fundamentals such as data structures, algorithms, distributed systems concepts, model lifecycle management, and secure coding and data handling practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing and implementing scalable, fault tolerant, and high throughput ML services, including well structured online/offline data models and APIs that serve multiple teams or domains.

  • Demonstrated track record of improving ML service availability, performance, and reliability using metrics, observability, automation, and strong operational practices such as canary releases and automated rollback.

  • Background integrating or leveraging AI/ML enabled platforms, feature stores, and training/serving infrastructure within production systems, and safely operating AI driven features to enhance customer and business outcomes.

  • Experience working across multiple technical domains or layers of the stack (for example, data pipelines, model training, and model serving APIs), adapting quickly to new ML frameworks, platforms, and AI driven tooling.

  • Ability to contribute to and influence ML system designs within a team or product area, making data driven decisions using experimentation and evaluation metrics, and helping evolve engineering and ML best practices for responsible and safe AI.

Job Summary

Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Genuine Engineering team. This group protects Adobe's ecosystem from fraud, abuse, and misuse using intelligent systems worldwide.

In this position, you will build and develop machine learning models from scratch, including custom transformer-based frameworks, to identify fraudulent actions, stop account sharing, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. You will manage the entire model lifecycle: raw behavioral data and feature engineering, architecture development, large-scale GPU training, deployment, and monitoring.

The team is actively building in-house behavioral foundation models that learn identity-preserving representations from long sequences of user activity. This is a role for an engineer who wants to own deep learning systems end-to-end - not consume pre-built ones.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and train deep learning models from scratch, including custom transformer and attention-based architectures for long behavioral event sequences.
  • Own the full training stack: event tokenization, temporal and positional embeddings, self-supervised pretraining (e.g., masked modeling, contrastive learning), and downstream fine-tuning.
  • Train large models efficiently on GPU infrastructure using mixed-precision training, gradient accumulation/checkpointing, efficient attention, and distributed strategies (DDP, FSDP, or equivalent).
  • Build and optimize feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw behavioral events into high-quality model inputs.
  • Translate prototypes into production ML systems - scalable, reliable, and observable - and drive inference performance through architectural and serving-side optimization.
  • Contribute to MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, automated retraining, and production monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and platform teams; mentor junior engineers on experimentation rigor, deployment process, and responsible AI.
  • Stay current with advances in ML/AI and bring relevant innovations into Adobe's products.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience building and deploying ML solutions at scale.
  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.
  • Deep understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle from data collection to deployment and monitoring.
  • Strong grasp of model optimization, inference efficiency, and production system integration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in fraud detection, anomaly detection, or behavioral modeling.

Staff Machine Learning Engineer (Data & Audience Platform), Hyderabad

About the Role

The Staff MLE is the senior-most individual contributor on the Hyderabad ML Engineering team. You will set the technical direction for the team's most complex and strategically important ML systems, serve as the technical authority across multiple concurrent workstreams, and act as a force multiplier for the entire team. You will own the architecture of WBD's ML capabilities in Hyderabad spanning identity intelligence, audience intelligence, content affinity, and forecasting and be a key technical partner to the Senior ML Engineering Manager and Director. This role requires 8+ years of experience, exceptional depth across the ML stack, and the ability to influence technical decisions across organizational boundaries.

What You ll Do

Technical Vision & Architecture

  • Define and own the technical architecture for the team s core systems: the probabilistic identity spine, audience intelligence platform, content-affinity and genre-preference models, and ML-based forecasting.

  • Lead architectural decisions for the team s MLOps framework feature-store design, training-pipeline standards, model-serving patterns, and monitoring infrastructure on a Databricks-first architecture, integrating Snowflake and AWS SageMaker where each is the right tool.

  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies and approaches (e.g., DCR-native modeling, graph ML, agentic ML orchestration, LLM-augmented pipelines) with clear build/buy/partner assessments.

  • Drive standardization of ML practices across Hyderabad and align with global WBD ML engineering standards.

Flagship ML System Ownership

  • Architect and lead delivery of the probabilistic identity resolution system resolving unauthenticated device IDs and 1P cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence at scale across all WBD brands using entity resolution, embeddings/representation learning, calibration, candidate blocking, and champion/challenger promotion, with a roadmap toward person-level graphs (incl. GNNs) and real-time resolution.

  • Lead the evolution of Audience Intelligence: ML Promo Optimizer (layered retrieval + propensity + closed-loop measurement, toward mixture-of-experts), STAT v2 (two-tower single-title affinity with semantic content embeddings), lookalike modeling (LAL 2.0+) inside Snowflake DCR, and content segmentation.

  • Own the ML architecture for forecasting (audience growth, demand, yield/pricing) and ensure models are production-grade, monitored, and continuously improved.

  • Drive the roadmap for bringing ML personalization signals (genre/content affinity, engagement trends) into batch and, over time, real-time activation paths.

MLOps Platform Leadership

  • Define the team s MLOps target architecture: feature contracts, model-registry governance, automated retraining, drift detection, and A/B experimentation infrastructure.

  • Establish engineering standards for the full ML lifecycle: data contracts feature engineering training evaluation deployment monitoring deprecation.

  • Champion a lightweight, adoptable, well-documented architecture (Databricks Asset Bundles, GitHub Actions CI/CD, MLflow throughout, feature tables, inference/monitoring tables), with leakage prevention, reproducibility, and FinOps controls baked in.

Agentic AI & Emerging Capabilities

  • Lead the team s adoption of agentic AI development: define standards for using Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Amazon Q in production ML workflows, and for MCP-based tooling.

  • Architect the team s use of Databricks Genie at scale Genie Space governance, Unity Catalog semantic-layer standards, and knowledge-store curation so ML outputs (audience scores, identity confidence, affinity signals) are self-serviceable by Marketing, Ad Sales, and Product without engineering intervention.

  • Own the team s Snowflake Cortex strategy Cortex Analyst / Copilot embedded into internal tooling, Cortex Search for RAG-based internal knowledge, and (where valuable) Cortex Fine-Tuning on WBD audience/identity vocabulary.

  • Architect agentic ML workflows for high-value automation (feature-selection and hyperparameter agents, data-quality monitoring agents, model-card generation) and evaluate emerging paradigms (DCR-native training, real-time feature serving) for the production roadmap.

Organizational Influence & Mentorship

  • Serve as the technical anchor for Hyderabad; provide architectural guidance and deep mentorship to Senior and MLE 2 engineers.

  • Partner with the Senior ML Engineering Manager on technical roadmap prioritization, headcount planning, and team capability development.

Machine Learning Engineer

Job Summary
This role directly supports our strategic shift toward machine learning, predictive analytics, and Agentic development in the region, enabling faster and more reliable delivery of insights and outcomes for APAC stakeholders on our modern data platforms.


Responsibilities
  • Data Processing at Scale . Clean, transform, and join raw datasets, handling missing data, outliers, normalization, and leakage prevention using SQL and Python .
  • Design and develop ML models tailored to business needs, leveraging statistical methods to ensure accuracy and reliability. Apply classical and modern techniques including regression, classification, time series analysis, and hypothesis testing to build trustworthy models.
  • Implement ML algorithms with an emphasis on performance and interpretability.
    Select appropriate algorithms and use statistical techniques to optimize hyperparameters, reduce variance and bias, and manage class imbalance.
  • Conduct disciplined experiments to test and validate models. Design experimental frameworks, use train validation test splits and cross validation, and interpret results with appropriate statistical significance and confidence intervals.
  • Feature engineering rooted in business and statistical understanding. Create informative features through aggregation, encoding, interaction terms, and time windows; assess feature importance and stability over time.
  • Model evaluation using statistically sound metrics. Evaluate with precision, recall, F1 score, ROC AUC, calibration, confusion matrices, and cost sensitive metrics appropriate to the problem.
  • Collaborate with data scientists to embed statistical insights into model design and validation, ensuring robust predictive analytics and practical deployment pathways.
  • Optimize and productionize models for reliability and speed. Tune hyperparameters, apply regularization and ensembling, implement monitoring for drift and performance, and manage A/B rollouts on Databricks and related tooling.

Principal Full-Stack Developer – Full  Time -IST


Location: Hyderabad
Job Type: Full Time


About the Role
We are seeking a Principal Full-Stack Developer to lead the design and development of scalable, secure, and cloud-native software solutions.
The primary focus of this role is full-stack software development and architecture, with strong hands-on experience across backend and frontend technologies. The ideal candidate will also have practical knowledge of cloud infrastructure and database services (Azure, AWS, or OCI) and modern software delivery practices.
DevOps is a secondary responsibility. The candidate should understand how CI/CD pipelines, how to build automation, deployments, monitoring, and release processes work, but this is not primarily an infrastructure administration role.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture and development of full-stack applications.
  • Design scalable backend services, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. Programming languages used may vary, though typically it is C#, Java, Python, or Node.
  • Build responsive and maintainable frontend applications. Technologies may vary, but React and Angular are commonly used by our clients as well as frameworks like Twitter Bootstrap, Material Design, or Tailwind. 
  • Experience using AI Coding agents effectively is a plus, though we can also train you on the job to use these tools effectively (configuring AGENTS.md, skills, plan versus build modes, etc)
  • Make architectural decisions covering performance, security, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Develop and integrate applications using Azure, OCI, or AWS services.
  • Design database schemas and data-access strategies using SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Review code and establish engineering standards across projects.
  • Guide teams in software architecture, design patterns, testing, and delivery practices.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, cloud, security, and operations teams. Strong  communication skills and ability to learn a customer’s business domain is a must. 
  • Troubleshoot complex application, integration, performance, and production issues.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline design and deployment automation. Technologies can include simple bash scripting, kubernetes/containerization, Ansible, or terraform, though we do not expect you to be an expert in all of these.
  • Understand and improve build, release, rollback, and environment-promotion processes.
  • Support observability through logging, monitoring, alerting, and application diagnostics.
  • Mentor senior and junior engineers.
  • Adapt quickly across different client domains, technology stacks, and project requirements.

Required Skills and Experience


  • 9 + years of professional experience in software development, architecture, or related engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing full-stack applications.
  • Professional experience with at least one backend technology, such as:
    • .NET/C# (preferred)
    • Python (preferred)
    • Java (nice to have)
    • Node.js (nice to have)
  • Strong frontend experience with one or more modern frameworks:
    • React  (preferred)
    • React Native (preferred)
    • Angular (nice to have)
    • Vue.js (nice to have)
  • Proven experience designing REST APIs, microservices, integrations, and distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle DB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with NoSQL databases is beneficial.
  • Hands-on application development experience with Microsoft Azure, OCI, or AWS.
  • Understanding of cloud services such as compute, storage, databases, messaging, serverless, identity, networking, and monitoring.
  • Strong knowledge of software architecture principles, design patterns, clean code, and testing.
  • Experience with Git-based development workflows and code reviews.
  • Understanding of CI/CD concepts, including:
    • Build and release pipelines
    • Automated testing
    • Artifact management
    • Environment-specific configuration
    • Deployment approvals
    • Rollbacks
  • Working knowledge of Docker and containerized application deployment.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

DevOps and Cloud Knowledge
DevOps is a supporting responsibility. Candidates should have practical knowledge of:

  • Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar tools.
  • YAML or Classic CI/CD pipelines.
  • Infrastructure and application deployment workflows.
  • Docker and basic Kubernetes concepts is beneficial.
  • Environment management across development, QA, staging, and production.
  • Application logging, monitoring, and alerting.
  • Basic Terraform or Ansible knowledge is preferred.
  • Security practices for cloud-hosted applications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a technical lead, software architect, or principal engineer.
  • Experience modernizing legacy applications and migrating workloads to Azure, OCI, or AWS.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging platforms.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud-native application patterns.
  • Experience with API gateways, authentication, authorization, OAuth2, and OpenID Connect.
  • Familiarity with Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, or other NoSQL technologies.
  • Experience with observability tools such as Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or Datadog.
  • Experience working with AI-assisted development or integrating AI services into business applications.
  • Consulting experience across multiple clients and technology stacks.

Why Join Us?

  • Lead the technical direction of modern full-stack applications.
  • Work on challenging projects across multiple industries and technology platforms.
  • Influence architecture and engineering practices across client engagements.
  • Work with Azure, AWS, OCI, modern frontend frameworks, APIs, microservices, and cloud-native technologies.
  • Mentor engineers and help build high-performing development teams.
  • Participate in innovative software and AI-driven projects.
  • Receive competitive compensation aligned with experience and technical expertise.

  • Translate business and customer needs into maintainable technical solutions.
  • Design REST APIs, database models and background-processing workflows.
  • Write tests, review code, debug production issues and improve performance and reliability.
  • Work with PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch and cloud infrastructure as the project requires.
  • Build or integrate applied AI capabilities when they create measurable user value.
  • Communicate progress, technical trade-offs and risks clearly within the team and with clients.
Core requirements
  • 3+ years of professional software-development experience.
  • Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with Django and Django REST Framework.
  • Experience designing, testing and maintaining production REST APIs.
  • Practical React experience using modern JavaScript (ES6+), hooks and reusable component patterns.
  • Familiarity with TypeScript or the ability to become productive with it quickly.
  • Strong SQL fundamentals and experience with PostgreSQL schema design, indexes and query troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization and secure API development.
  • Experience with automated testing, Git-based workflows and collaborative code reviews.
  • Working knowledge of Docker and application deployment.
  • Ability to independently break down moderately complex problems and deliver maintainable solutions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, ownership and care for product quality.
Applied AI experience - preferred
This is a full-stack engineering role with applied AI responsibilities, not a model-research position. We value practical experience shipping reliable AI-enabled software.
  • Integrating an LLM or ML inference API into a production, open-source or substantial personal application.
  • Structured model outputs, tool/function calling, embeddings, semantic search or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Evaluating AI output with representative test cases and measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Awareness of hallucinations, prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure and unsafe model actions.
  • Handling model latency, retries, rate limits, token usage, observability and cost.
  • Responsible use of AI-assisted development tools, including reviewing, testing and owning generated code.
  • Good judgment about when a deterministic software solution is more appropriate than AI.
Good to have
  • Celery, RabbitMQ or other asynchronous processing systems.
  • Elasticsearch, Redis, MySQL or MongoDB.
  • AWS or GCP, CI/CD pipelines, Nginx and production observability.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS applications or data-intensive products.
  • Pandas, scikit-learn and practical ML fundamentals such as validation, precision/recall, data leakage and model drift.
  • Experience working directly with customers or converting ambiguous requirements into deliverable increments.
Tech stack
Python Django Django REST Framework React JavaScript (ES6+) TypeScript PostgreSQL REST APIs Docker Git Automated testing Applied AI / LLM APIs

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with expertise in Java, C++, Golang, as well as strong front-end and back-end development skills. The ideal candidate will have a passion for building innovative web applications, with a solid understanding of both server-side and client-side technologies. As a Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and efficient applications, ensuring high performance, and delivering a seamless user experience.

Key Responsibilities:

Backend Development:
o Design, implement, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure backend systems using Java, C++, and Golang.
o Develop RESTful APIs and services to enable smooth communication between the front end and the backend.
o Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement server-side logic and architecture.
o Integrate third-party APIs and services into the system to enhance functionality.
Frontend Development:
o Develop dynamic, responsive, and user-friendly web interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js).

Kolkata, West Bengal, India | On-site, 5 days per week | 5+ years | Full-time, permanent


About the Company

Our client is a global technology consulting and engineering firm with delivery hubs in Canada and India, working as one global, local team. They partner with organizations across finance, insurance, utilities, technology, and the not-for-profit sector on cloud modernization, custom application development, data engineering, applied AI, and managed services.


They are a Certified Great Place to Work. Every engagement is led end-to-end by senior architects and technical leads, and the India engineering team works directly with the Canadian team rather than at arm's length.


About the Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer (Intermediate/Senior) to design and build cloud-native applications and integrations that sit at the centre of client digital ecosystems.

You will join a team of five in Kolkata and work across the stack, using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React and Angular on the front end, Node.js and PHP services on the back end, relational and NoSQL data stores underneath, and APIs and serverless technologies to connect applications with CRM, marketing technology, content management, and other business platforms.

This is a hands-on engineering role with real technical ownership. You will translate business requirements into resilient technical solutions, write production-grade code, deploy through automated pipelines, and mentor less experienced engineers along the way.

On a team this size, your work is visible. You will work with a high degree of independence in a fast-paced agile setting and be expected to raise the bar on quality and maintainability across the full software development lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain full stack web applications using technologies such as React, Angular, Node.js, Next.js, NestJS, PHP, serverless functions, CRM and marketing technology platforms, and WordPress.
  • Build and consume secure, well-documented RESTful APIs and lead integrations between custom applications and third-party platforms.
  • Develop and support integrations with CRM, marketing automation, customer communications, and other business platforms. This may include HubSpot or comparable platforms, using APIs, webhooks, workflows, custom objects, serverless functions, and other integration patterns to connect customer and marketing data with business applications.
  • Design and build serverless and event-driven solutions to support application workflows, integrations, automation, and data movement between systems.
  • Model, query, and optimize data across relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server and NoSQL stores such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, and Cosmos DB, including schema design, indexing, and migrations.
  • Architect and deploy cloud-native solutions, with a strong preference for Microsoft Azure and services such as Azure Functions, API Management, Blob Storage, managed databases, and containerized workloads.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable tools, containerize services with Docker, and contribute to infrastructure automation and environment management.
  • Work with product managers, designers, architects, and QA engineers to turn requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria into technical designs and delivery estimates.
  • Write unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and uphold engineering standards for security, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues and contribute to monitoring, logging, and observability practices that reduce mean time to resolution.
  • Participate in all agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
  • Mentor less experienced developers and contribute to engineering standards and continuous improvement across the team.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on professional full stack development experience, including ownership of features from design through production release.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field from an accredited university.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux and Ubuntu environments. This is a working requirement of the role, and a Windows-only background will not be a fit.
  • Strong backend engineering experience with Node.js frameworks and PHP frameworks, including modular architecture, authentication and authorization, API design, and third-party integrations.
  • Production experience building modern front ends with React and/or Angular, with the ability to work confidently across modern JavaScript and TypeScript applications.
  • Hands-on experience integrating CRM, marketing automation, customer communications, MarTech, or comparable business platforms. HubSpot experience is valuable but is not mandatory. Candidates with comparable platform experience or strong serverless and API integration experience will also be considered.
  • Strong experience designing and building integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, workflows, serverless functions, event-driven services, or similar integration patterns.
  • Solid database skills across at least one relational and one NoSQL platform, including query optimization and data modelling for transactional applications.
  • Practical experience designing, deploying, and operating cloud-based workloads. Microsoft Azure is strongly preferred, although relevant cloud-native and serverless experience on platforms such as AWS will also be considered.
  • Working DevOps capability, including Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipeline configuration, Docker, and environment and release management.
  • Proven delivery experience in an agile environment alongside cross-functional teams.
  • A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership who can drive work forward with minimal supervision.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to pick up unfamiliar platforms, technologies, and codebases quickly.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on HubSpot development, including HubSpot APIs, private apps, custom objects, workflows, webhooks, CMS, or HubSpot integrations.
  • Experience with other CRM, marketing automation, MarTech, or customer communications platforms.
  • Background in startups or product-based companies.
  • Experience with Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, or other serverless technologies.
  • Infrastructure as code using Terraform or Bicep.
  • Test automation with Jest, Playwright, or Cypress.
  • Exposure to data engineering pipelines, ETL, analytics, or BI tooling.
  • Experience applying AI or LLM-based capabilities in production applications.
  • Azure, HubSpot, or other relevant technical certifications.
  • Familiarity with secure coding practices, including OWASP Top 10.
  • Consulting or professional services experience working directly with clients across concurrent engagements.
  • Understanding of enterprise SDLC and delivery governance.

What We Offer

  • Senior-level technical mentorship on every engagement, with clear paths toward lead and architect roles.
  • Varied, high-impact work across industries, including modernization programs, greenfield builds, integrations, cloud-native development, and applied AI initiatives.
  • Direct collaboration with our Canada-based team, not siloed offshore delivery.
  • A collaborative, globally local team culture recognized through our Great Place to Work certification.
  • Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and support for professional development and certification.

Location

  • This is an on-site position in Kolkata, West Bengal, 5 days per week. Candidates must currently be based in Kolkata or be willing and able to relocate.
  • The role involves regular collaboration with Canada-based teams and clients, which requires some overlap with North American business hours.
  • Candidates must be legally eligible to work in India.

Own a feature from the database to the browser, and prove it works. We hire for ability, not years. Read the whole description before you apply.

Before you apply

Were direct about how we work. Read this section first.

We value engineers who know what they dont know, and say so. If youre honest about your gaps, well invest in closing them. If you hide weaknesses or oversell your experience, you wont last here.

We expect you to use AI coding tools. Everyone here does, and pretending otherwise in 2026 would be theatre. What we care about is what happens next. Roughly two in five lines of committed code across the industry are now AI-written, while fewer than half of developers say they always verify that code before committing it, and in a controlled security study 45 percent of AI-generated samples introduced a vulnerability from the OWASP top ten. The failure mode is specific, and it is not sloppiness. AI code arrives with clean syntax and consistent naming, so the signals that used to make bad code obvious are gone. What hides underneath is a misunderstood requirement or an edge case nobody considered. Reading it for style tells you nothing. You have to work out what the change was supposed to do and then check whether it does that.

So the skill we hire for is not typing and it is not prompting. It is knowing when you are done. You can delegate the work. You cannot delegate the accountability.

We are also not going to tell you that AI makes everyone ten times faster. The one properly controlled study on this found experienced developers were 19 percent slower with AI while believing they had been faster, and the follow-up could not be completed because developers refused to work without the tools. The productivity question is genuinely open. The verification cost is the part that has actually been measured.

We move fast. Growth happens outside comfort zones. If this sounds harsh, were probably not a fit. If it sounds like the environment youve been looking for, keep reading.

The role

Allerin builds AI and IoT products: edge to cloud video intelligence, computer vision systems, and data platforms. We also partner with select clients to solve their hardest technical problems. Youll do both.

Youll work across a Rails API backend and a React admin frontend, on a production system with roughly 160 models, 231 controllers, and five separate API surfaces covering dashboard, mobile, valet, kiosk, and AI/ML integrations. This is not greenfield. You are joining a system that already has users, and the work is to extend it without breaking what runs.

  • Location: Navi Mumbai
  • Team: Engineering
  • Works alongside: the Backend Team Lead, who owns architecture, and the test automation engineer, who owns the automated suites
What youll own Features, end to end
  • Take a feature from schema and migration through the API to the React screen a person actually uses, and stay with it after it ships.
  • Design endpoints with clean contracts, sensible pagination, consistent errors, and no surprises for the clients that consume them.
  • Write the tests that would catch your own mistake, not the tests that pass.
The surfaces where AI meets a person
  • Build the screens where a models output reaches a human: review and override queues, confidence shown honestly, audit trails of who decided what.
  • Treat a prediction as a probability rather than a fact. A vision model at 97 percent confidence is still wrong often enough that the interface has to say so.
  • Make the numbers visible. If a client is told false positives fell 85 percent, something you built is where that number comes from.
Verification
  • Know what you ran, what it proved, and what it did not. "The tests pass" is the beginning of that sentence, not the end of it.
  • Review AI-written changes, including your own, for intent rather than style.
  • Break your own work before someone else does, and say plainly when it is not ready.
A codebase you did not write
  • Read code, git history, and other peoples decisions before changing them.
  • Ask why something is the way it is before deciding it is wrong. Occasionally it is wrong, and then you fix it properly.
What we expect you can do

We dont count years. We look for evidence, because someone can do a thing for five years and have nothing to show for it. Bring work we can look at and talk about, and be ready for us to go deep on it.

  • Build and ship a full feature in a server framework and a modern JavaScript frontend. Rails and React are our stack, and Rails experience is a real advantage, but a strong engineer from Django, Laravel, Node, or Spring who wants to work in Rails is not disqualified.
  • Model data properly in a relational database, and read a query plan when something is slow.
  • Debug something you did not write, from a symptom, without guessing.
  • Use AI tools well, and describe where you stop trusting them.
  • Write clearly. Half this job is explaining a change to someone who was not in your head when you made it.

No degree requirement. We will look at what you have built.

Nice to have
  • Rails at production scale, including background jobs and API versioning
  • Work on a product where a machine learning models output reached a user
  • Performance work with real numbers attached, before and after
  • Anything you have written or open sourced that shows how you think
This role is NOT for you if
  • You want tickets specified down to the last detail before you start.
  • You ship what an assistant produced without being able to say why it is correct.
  • "The tests passed" is your complete answer to whether something works.
  • You want to avoid the legacy parts of the system and only build new things.
  • You need a title before you are willing to own an outcome.
What we offer
  • Real ownership of features that reach production and get measured
  • A senior engineering team that reviews code properly and expects the same of you
  • Investment in your growth if youre honest about where you need it
  • Problems that are genuinely hard, on systems that genuinely run
How we hire

Apply through the form. The questions are built to surface how you think, not how well you can prompt a language model. A human reads every application, and answers that read as model-generated are tested in depth in the interview, where they do not survive. Everything you write will be discussed in depth if we talk.

If we do talk, one round is a code review. We hand you a change an AI tool wrote against a small Rails application, with a real defect in it, and ask you two questions. Is this safe to merge, and how do you know. Bring whatever tools you normally use. We are watching how you decide you are finished, which is the part of the job that got harder.

Own a feature from the database to the browser, and prove it works. We hire for ability, not years. Read the whole description before you apply.

Before you apply

Were direct about how we work. Read this section first.

We value engineers who know what they dont know, and say so. If youre honest about your gaps, well invest in closing them. If you hide weaknesses or oversell your experience, you wont last here.

We expect you to use AI coding tools. Everyone here does, and pretending otherwise in 2026 would be theatre. What we care about is what happens next. Roughly two in five lines of committed code across the industry are now AI-written, while fewer than half of developers say they always verify that code before committing it, and in a controlled security study 45 percent of AI-generated samples introduced a vulnerability from the OWASP top ten. The failure mode is specific, and it is not sloppiness. AI code arrives with clean syntax and consistent naming, so the signals that used to make bad code obvious are gone. What hides underneath is a misunderstood requirement or an edge case nobody considered. Reading it for style tells you nothing. You have to work out what the change was supposed to do and then check whether it does that.

So the skill we hire for is not typing and it is not prompting. It is knowing when you are done. You can delegate the work. You cannot delegate the accountability.

We are also not going to tell you that AI makes everyone ten times faster. The one properly controlled study on this found experienced developers were 19 percent slower with AI while believing they had been faster, and the follow-up could not be completed because developers refused to work without the tools. The productivity question is genuinely open. The verification cost is the part that has actually been measured.

We move fast. Growth happens outside comfort zones. If this sounds harsh, were probably not a fit. If it sounds like the environment youve been looking for, keep reading.

The role

Allerin builds AI and IoT products: edge to cloud video intelligence, computer vision systems, and data platforms. We also partner with select clients to solve their hardest technical problems. Youll do both.

Youll work across a Rails API backend and a React admin frontend, on a production system with roughly 160 models, 231 controllers, and five separate API surfaces covering dashboard, mobile, valet, kiosk, and AI/ML integrations. This is not greenfield. You are joining a system that already has users, and the work is to extend it without breaking what runs.

  • Location: Navi Mumbai
  • Team: Engineering
  • Works alongside: the Backend Team Lead, who owns architecture, and the test automation engineer, who owns the automated suites
What youll own Features, end to end
  • Take a feature from schema and migration through the API to the React screen a person actually uses, and stay with it after it ships.
  • Design endpoints with clean contracts, sensible pagination, consistent errors, and no surprises for the clients that consume them.
  • Write the tests that would catch your own mistake, not the tests that pass.
The surfaces where AI meets a person
  • Build the screens where a models output reaches a human: review and override queues, confidence shown honestly, audit trails of who decided what.
  • Treat a prediction as a probability rather than a fact. A vision model at 97 percent confidence is still wrong often enough that the interface has to say so.
  • Make the numbers visible. If a client is told false positives fell 85 percent, something you built is where that number comes from.
Verification
  • Know what you ran, what it proved, and what it did not. "The tests pass" is the beginning of that sentence, not the end of it.
  • Review AI-written changes, including your own, for intent rather than style.
  • Break your own work before someone else does, and say plainly when it is not ready.
A codebase you did not write
  • Read code, git history, and other peoples decisions before changing them.
  • Ask why something is the way it is before deciding it is wrong. Occasionally it is wrong, and then you fix it properly.
What we expect you can do

We dont count years. We look for evidence, because someone can do a thing for five years and have nothing to show for it. Bring work we can look at and talk about, and be ready for us to go deep on it.

  • Build and ship a full feature in a server framework and a modern JavaScript frontend. Rails and React are our stack, and Rails experience is a real advantage, but a strong engineer from Django, Laravel, Node, or Spring who wants to work in Rails is not disqualified.
  • Model data properly in a relational database, and read a query plan when something is slow.
  • Debug something you did not write, from a symptom, without guessing.
  • Use AI tools well, and describe where you stop trusting them.
  • Write clearly. Half this job is explaining a change to someone who was not in your head when you made it.

No degree requirement. We will look at what you have built.

Nice to have
  • Rails at production scale, including background jobs and API versioning
  • Work on a product where a machine learning models output reached a user
  • Performance work with real numbers attached, before and after
  • Anything you have written or open sourced that shows how you think
This role is NOT for you if
  • You want tickets specified down to the last detail before you start.
  • You ship what an assistant produced without being able to say why it is correct.
  • "The tests passed" is your complete answer to whether something works.
  • You want to avoid the legacy parts of the system and only build new things.
  • You need a title before you are willing to own an outcome.
What we offer
  • Real ownership of features that reach production and get measured
  • A senior engineering team that reviews code properly and expects the same of you
  • Investment in your growth if youre honest about where you need it
  • Problems that are genuinely hard, on systems that genuinely run
How we hire

Apply through the form. The questions are built to surface how you think, not how well you can prompt a language model. A human reads every application, and answers that read as model-generated are tested in depth in the interview, where they do not survive. Everything you write will be discussed in depth if we talk.

If we do talk, one round is a code review. We hand you a change an AI tool wrote against a small Rails application, with a real defect in it, and ask you two questions. Is this safe to merge, and how do you know. Bring whatever tools you normally use. We are watching how you decide you are finished, which is the part of the job that got harder.

Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Full Stack Developer to build and maintain scalable backend systems that power our products. This role will focus on developing APIs, microservices and Front End while ensuring reliability, performance, and maintainability across our platform.
You will work closely with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and DevOps to deliver high-quality solutions aligned with business goals.


Responsibilities
  • Design and ship features across the full stack: Prisma models and SQL migrations, SDL and resolvers, services with colocated Jest tests, and Ant Design screens.
  • Extend and harden the multi-tenant model: tenant-scoped data access, tenant provisioning and cloning, per-tenant licensing and module enablement.
  • Work on the scheduling and work-queue layer: job allocation, worker claiming, stale-job recovery, concurrency and idempotency.
  • Write the docs that go out with each release and keep internal runbooks current.
  • Improve what we know is weak: front-end test coverage, query performance on large scan result sets, and observability.
  • Integrate backend services with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile Scrum environment and participate in ceremonies
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following established coding standards
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and support build and deployment processes
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues in development and production environments
  • Continuously improve code quality, performance, and system reliability
  • Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls.


Experience and Desired Skills
  • 3-4 years building and operating production web applications, with TypeScript on both Node.js and React.
  • Hands-on experience with Node.js and Java building APIs or microservices
  • Designed and maintained a GraphQL API in production, schema-first, including auth directives, pagination and N+1 avoidance.
  • Schema design, migrations, indexes, views, and reading query plans. Experience with Prisma or a comparable ORM and knowledge of when to drop to raw SQL.
  • React with a component library such as Ant Design, building data-dense screens, tables, filters and dashboards. Comfortable with charting libraries.
  • Built or maintained background-job systems: queues, schedulers, workers, retries, locking. Can reason about race conditions and write tests that expose them.
  • Docker in daily use. Deployed and debugged services on AWS, including ECS or a comparable container platform, RDS, S3 and a CI pipeline.
